results.title: 10 million years ago, giant 23-foot crocodilians ruled Miocene South America, hunted massive mammals, dominated the food chain: fossil evidence reveals
results.description: The wetlands of ancient South America were vibrant ecosystems, inhabited by extraordinary species. Dominating this landscape were colossal crocodilians, some measuring 23 feet in length. These formidable hunters preyed on large mammals, playing a crucial role in the food webs of their era. Yet, as geological transformations occurred, the era of these majestic reptiles came to an end.

results.title: Madhya Pradesh August 18, 2026, Weather Update: Heavy Rain Likely In 14 Districts Over Next 3 Days; Showers Expected In Others
results.description: Madhya Pradesh is on alert for heavy rainfall, with 14 districts including Rewa and Balaghat under warning. IMD has forecast heavy rain for the next three days, while nine gates of Bargi Dam may open on Tuesday. Over 20 districts are yet to meet their seasonal rain quota, though 15 districts have recorded above-average rainfall.
